authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.64 describes the R2004+ VPORT xdictionary-missing flag, xref-block hard pointer and R2000+ named/base UCS hard pointers.
scope: Only a synthesized *ACTIVE VPORT in AC1018+ gets missing-xdictionary=1 and typed-null hard pointers for xref and named/base UCS. The existing public encoder signature, public VPORT layout and caller-supplied records retain their previous behavior; the new encoder method is private. AC1015 is unchanged.
source_evidence: LibreDWG 0.14 decodes the ODA-produced AC1018 LINE source with missing=1 and xref, named UCS and base UCS all (5,0,0). It independently decodes current generated AC1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 synthetic VPORTs with the same roles and a following LINE; AC1015 retains untyped nulls and lacks the R2004 flag.

oda_factorial.reader: ODA File Converter 27.1.0 ACAD2013 DXF; check .err and actual output rather than process status
oda_factorial.prerequisite: All eight locally generated AC1018 controls include the independently witnessed scratch plotstyle graph and preceding linetype corrections; the graph is not yet automatic in production.
oda_factorial.varied_bits: 1=missing-xdictionary flag, 2=typed-null xref, 4=typed-null named and base UCS
oda_factorial.partial_result: Masks 0 through 6 each produce no DXF and report Object improperly read: <AcDbViewportTableRecord> (16), previous error .dwg file needs recovery.
oda_factorial.all_three_result: No DXF; Object improperly read: <AcDbRegAppTableRecord> (14), previous error .dwg file needs recovery.
oda_factorial.interpretation: The error boundary moves only with all three tested corrections. This does not establish the subsequent APPID error's cause or full ODA compatibility.

tests: libdxfrw_dwg_header_writer_sealing PASS: six-version synthesized/caller VPORT state, invalid-height no-output rollback and same-writer retry, following LINE readback, and exact typed-null handle-byte ordering for each AC1018+ version.
